title: Local nonfalsification factor
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a conjunction of literals with pairwise distinct coordinates, let $i\\in\\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and let $c$ be a coordinate restriction. If $i$ is in the support of $T$, the local nonfalsification factor is $0$ when the literal at $i$ is falsified by the constant restriction $c$, and is $1$ otherwise; if $i$ is outside the support, the factor is $1$.
